title: Borland claims first-hand knowledge of crash recovery, reverse engineering and the power source

tellings.quote: I have direct first-hand knowledge and exposure to crash recovery, reverse engineering, integration of technology into

plain: A man named Dylan Borland says he has "direct first-hand knowledge and exposure" to crash recovery, meaning the retrieval of crashed non-human craft, and to reverse engineering, meaning taking that technology apart to learn how it works and fitting it into human systems, along with knowledge of its power source. Borland says this on the show as his own claim, giving no date or place. If true, it would mean a living witness has worked on such craft himself.
